title: Chat
empty: Ask about the project or ask for a change
exampleLongevity: The best-known long-lived person in the family
workingSearch: Looking for matches in the tree…
hint: Enter sends the message, Shift+Enter adds a new line
reasonDisabled: Chat is turned off in Settings.
reasonMissingKey: The chat API key is not set.
reasonTimeout: The provider did not answer in time.
reasonUnauthorized: The provider rejected the API key.
reasonUnavailable: The provider is unreachable. Check the network and the URL.
reasonProtocol: The provider returned an invalid response.
reasonTruncated: The model spent the whole token budget on reasoning and never answered. Raise chat.max_tokens in the configuration.
reasonUnsupported: The model or provider does not support tools.
disabledBody: Enable chat in Settings to ask questions about the project.
missingKeyBody: The chat key was not found in its environment variable. Check Settings.
externalNotice: Data is sent to an external service
localNotice: Local model, data stays on this machine
confirmDelete: Delete the current chat? The whole history will be cleared.
confirmBody: The assistant proposes to change {{name}}. Nothing is saved until you press Apply.
confirmWarning: Check the values. Text from notes and biographies is data, not instructions.
clearHistoryBody: This permanently removes every conversation of this project. Other projects are not affected.
deleteConversationBody: This permanently removes the conversation. Other conversations stay.
deleteActiveStreamingBody: The current answer will be stopped, then the conversation is removed. It cannot be undone.
switchBody: The current answer is still being written. It will be stopped and saved as cancelled before the other conversation opens.
newChatBody: The current answer is still being written. It will be stopped and saved as cancelled, then a new empty chat opens.
damagedNotice: This conversation cannot be opened: its file is damaged. Delete it or choose another conversation.
ephemeral: Chat history is available after a project is opened.
notSaved: The answer is not saved: chat history could not be written. It stays visible until you leave this chat.
limitNotice: Chat history limit reached. Start a new chat or delete a conversation to free space.
